items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I certainly would like to have Larry involved with me and try to get it in the schools.

ctx.x: Larry...people like that. I want to work closely with them and do what I can do to help. Because Boogie-Woogie can fit in anyplace, you know, and I could explain what it is, you know what I mean, and sometime this is good. This may be an interesting item for youngsters to see. Well, I certainly would like to have Larry involved with me and try to get it in the schools.
Yeah, he is on a committee at the National Endowment for the Arts...Music in Schools. And...
